integrity: Proof uses exact polygon cap moments, rational interval bounds for finitely many side counts, a disk comparison for all remaining counts, and a separate analytic radial asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Uniform area on filled regular polygons; real affine projection; no claim for irregular polygons, higher-degree polynomials, or monotonicity in side count. An equivalent unindexed treatment remains possible.
title: Sharp positivity crossover and polygon-to-disk second-order law for affine least squares
